outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: None that matter here (formatting, URLs, or minor phrasing are irrelevant because the core requested data wasn’t produced).

Critical issues: (1) Missing primary deliverable: the agent did not report the required title + complete release-group “First release date” for the first three dated Album entries. It did not provide even one complete entry. (2) Incomplete navigation: per the action history and DOM evidence, the agent opened only the first album release-group (“Homework”) and never opened the second (“Discovery”) or third (“Human After All”) release-group pages. (3) Unsupported blocker claim: the agent claims it “cannot scroll or reveal any hidden section,” but there is no confirmed environment blocker (no captcha/login wall/down site), and the task required continuing to other album entries even if one page layout was confusing. The DOM snapshots show the “Homework” release-group page and its Details tab, but they do not show any extracted “First release date” field/value, and the agent did not attempt/complete the rest of the required workflow.

Outcome assessment: From an average user’s perspective, the task was not completed. The user asked for three album titles and their release-group First release dates, sourced from each release-group page. The agent provided zero of the requested title+date outputs and stopped after failing to locate the first date, without proceeding to the next entries. Therefore the primary intent was not satisfied.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to read the Daft Punk artist page on MusicBrainz, stay strictly within the standalone “Album” subsection of official release groups, open the first three dated album release-groups in the displayed chronological order, and report each release-group’s title plus the release-group page’s “First release date” (not an individual release date). A reasonable user would not be flexible on missing any of the three albums or missing/using the wrong kind of date, because those are the core requested deliverables.
